verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. For the rational-centred trace proposition, compactly supported tropical test forms and the verified top-form support and weight-one integration formulas turn d'd''[h]=0 into vanishing of every distributional second derivative of the Gauss-section trace. The trace is affine, and continuity as each radius tends to zero forces all slopes to vanish; common Gauss points compare rational centers, while Berkovich's verified interior formula and continuity handle closed-polydisc endpoints. For explicit base change, verified rigid-point density, scalar-extension surjectivity, affined G-tropical functoriality, and positivity of Hessian currents justify all three items. For the finite-flat trace, the verified smooth approximation, fibre-integration regularity, current projection formula, and commutation with d' and d'' establish continuity, p_*[h]=[Tr_p(h)], and Hessian preservation. Finally, the minimal-polynomial bounds give the stated finite polynomial maps of discs; the graded Gauss-valuation argument correctly proves the single Gauss fibre with degree d, the two trace fibres reduce every rigid value to h(0), and verified rigid-point density plus continuity proves constancy. All deductions, hypotheses, definitions, and 13 citation uses were checked in textual order; no critical error or gap was found.
